name: EPIC 248457070
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 6.9 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 2,200 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.17 solar masses and 6.9 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,747 K at its surface.
